product_overview: A FastAPI-based REST wrapper exposing 56 homelab infrastructure tools (SSH, VM/Container management, Proxmox, service installation, network discovery) with consistent JSON responses and OpenAPI docs. Tools that target external systems run a fast TCP preflight (SSH:22, Proxmox:8006) and surface reachable/unreachable status via 424 responses.
core_goals: Expose a consistent, documented REST surface for 56 infrastructure management tools with OpenAPI/Swagger at /docs.
Provide fast-fail external dependency preflight for tools targeting SSH and Proxmox to return deterministic 424 Failed Dependency responses when targets are unreachable.
Support discovery, topology mapping, credential storage, VM/container lifecycle, Proxmox operations, and template-driven service installation (Terraform/Ansible).
Keep local-state operations (sitemap, templates, credential listing) testable without external infrastructure.
Return consistent error formats (424, 412, 422, 400, 404, 500) so clients and tests can assert behavior.

features.name: System
features.description: Server health, metrics, and global tool discovery endpoints including auto-generated API docs and the OpenAPI spec.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", result: {server_status, uptime_seconds, total_requests, total_errors, error_rate, transport}}
GET /api/tools -> Receive 200 with {tools:[{name, description, category, requires_infrastructure, input_schema}], count:56}
GET /docs -> Receive 200 with HTML Swagger UI (auto-generated from per-tool schemas)
POST /api/tools/nonexistent_tool -> Receive 404 with {status: "error", error: "Not Found"}

features.name: SSH Tools
features.description: Discover and administer remote hosts over SSH (port 22). Endpoints run a TCP preflight to port 22 and return 424 if unreachable.
user_flows: POST /api/tools/ssh_discover with body {"hostname":"192.168.1.10","username":"root","password":"pass"} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", tool: "ssh_discover", result: {cpu, memory, disks, interfaces, os_version}}

POST /api/tools/ssh_execute_command with body {"hostname":"192.168.1.10","command":"uname -a","use_sudo":false} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", tool: "ssh_execute_command", result: "<command output>"}
POST /api/tools/start_interactive_shell with body {"hostname":"192.168.1.10","initial_command":"htop"} -> Receive 200 with {session_id, websocket_url}

POST /api/tools/ssh_discover with body {"hostname":"10.0.0.254"} -> Receive 424 failed_dependency with {status: "failed_dependency", host: "10.0.0.254", port: 22, protocol: "SSH", error, requires: "an SSH target host. Register credentials first: POST /api/tools/register_server"}
POST /api/tools/setup_mcp_admin with body {} -> Receive 422 (or 400) with {status: "error", tool: "setup_mcp_admin", error: "Missing required field 'hostname'"}

features.name: Network Discovery
features.description: Network mapping, topology analysis, and device tracking. Single-host discovers run SSH preflight; sitemap and analysis tools operate on the local SQLite DB.
user_flows: POST /api/tools/discover_and_map with body {"hostname":"192.168.1.11"} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", tool: "discover_and_map", result: {device_id, hostname, interfaces, os, recorded_at}}

POST /api/tools/bulk_discover_and_map with body {"targets":[{"hostname":"192.168.1.11"},{"hostname":"192.168.1.12"}]} -> Receive 200 with {status, total_targets:2, results:[{status, hostname, ...}, {status, hostname, ...}]}
POST /api/tools/get_network_sitemap with body {} -> Receive 200 with {devices: [ ... ]}
POST /api/tools/bulk_discover_and_map with body {} -> Receive 422 with {status: "error", error: "Missing or malformed `targets` array"}
POST /api/tools/discover_and_map with body {"hostname":"unreachable.example.com"} -> Receive 424 failed_dependency with {host, port:22, protocol:"SSH", requires}

features.name: VM & Container Management
features.description: Deploy and control Docker/LXD workloads via stored device registrations (targets are referenced by device_id). Returns 412 when the device_id is unknown or lacks registered infrastructure.
user_flows: POST /api/tools/deploy_vm with body {"device_id":42,"platform":"docker","vm_name":"web-1","vm_config":{"image":"nginx"}} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", tool: "deploy_vm", result: {container_id, access_info}}
POST /api/tools/list_vms with body {"device_id":42,"platform":"docker"} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", tool: "list_vms", result: [{container_id, name, status}] }

POST /api/tools/deploy_vm with body {"device_id":9999,"platform":"docker","vm_name":"web-unknown"} -> Receive 412 precondition_failed with {status: "precondition_failed", tool: "deploy_vm", error: "Device not found / no infrastructure registered", requires}
POST /api/tools/deploy_vm with body {"device_id":"not-an-int"} -> Receive 422 with {status: "error", error: "Validation error", details: [...]}

features.name: Service Installation
features.description: YAML-template-driven service installation with Terraform and Ansible support. Tools that target an external host preflight hostname:22.
user_flows: POST /api/tools/list_available_services with body {} -> Receive 200 with {available_services: ["jellyfin","pihole","ollama",...], count}
POST /api/tools/get_service_info with body {"service":"jellyfin"} -> Receive 200 with {service, description, requirements, templates}
POST /api/tools/check_service_requirements with body {"hostname":"192.168.1.12","service":"jellyfin"} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", result: {meets_requirements:true, details}}
POST /api/tools/install_service with body {"hostname":"192.168.1.12","service":"jellyfin"} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", result: {installation: "completed", access_urls: [...]} }
POST /api/tools/check_service_requirements with body {"hostname":"missing-host","service":"jellyfin"} -> Receive 424 failed_dependency with {host: "missing-host", port:22, protocol:"SSH", requires}
POST /api/tools/install_service with body {} -> Receive 422 with {status: "error", error: "Validation error", details: [...]}

features.name: Credentials
features.description: Store and manage SSH/Proxmox credentials. register_server performs an SSH preflight; listing and other ops are local-only.
user_flows: POST /api/tools/register_server with body {"hostname":"192.168.1.13","username":"admin","password":"s3cret"} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", tool: "register_server", result: "registered"}
POST /api/tools/list_registered_servers with body {} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", total_servers: N, servers: [{hostname, username, type}, ...]}
POST /api/tools/update_server_credentials with body {"hostname":"192.168.1.13","password":"n3wpwd"} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", result: "updated"}
POST /api/tools/register_server with body {"hostname":"unreachable-host","username":"admin"} -> Receive 424 failed_dependency with {host: "unreachable-host", port:22, protocol:"SSH", requires}
POST /api/tools/update_server_credentials with body {} -> Receive 422 with {status: "error", error: "Missing required field 'hostname'"}

features.name: Infrastructure Lifecycle
features.description: Manage multi-device deployments, backups, rollbacks, and validation. Lifecycle operations act on declarative plans (no per-request preflight) and provide preview/rollback capabilities.
user_flows: POST /api/tools/deploy_infrastructure with body {"plan": {"services": [...], "network": {...}}} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", tool: "deploy_infrastructure", result: {deployment_id, results_per_target}}
POST /api/tools/validate_infrastructure_changes with body {"plan": {"services": [...]}} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", result: {valid:true, issues:[]}}
POST /api/tools/rollback_infrastructure_changes_preview with body {"backup_id":"backup-123"} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", result: {preview_changes}}
POST /api/tools/deploy_infrastructure with body {} -> Receive 422 with {status: "error", error: "Validation error", details: [...]}

features.name: Proxmox
features.description: Manage Proxmox VE via the Proxmox API (port 8006). Most Proxmox tools preflight host:8006 and return 424 when the API is unreachable. Community script search uses GitHub and does not preflight.
user_flows: POST /api/tools/search_proxmox_scripts with body {"query":"docker"} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", query: "docker", total_found: N, scripts: [{name, path, download_url, category}, ...]}

POST /api/tools/list_proxmox_resources with body {"host":"192.168.1.200", "user":"root","password":"pass"} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", tool: "list_proxmox_resources", result: {nodes, vms, lxc, storage}}
POST /api/tools/get_proxmox_vm_status with body {"host":"192.168.1.200","vmid":100} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", result: {vmid, status, cpu, mem, uptime}}

POST /api/tools/list_proxmox_resources with body {"host":"unreachable-proxmox"} -> Receive 424 failed_dependency with {status: "failed_dependency", host: "unreachable-proxmox", port: 8006, protocol: "Proxmox API", error, requires}
POST /api/tools/get_proxmox_script_info with body {} -> Receive 422 with {status: "error", error: "Missing required field 'script_name'"}

features.name: Drift Detection
features.description: Scan live infrastructure (Proxmox and other managed resources) against stored baselines and report configuration/state drift.
user_flows: POST /api/tools/scan_infrastructure_drift with body {"hostname":"192.168.1.200"} -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", tool: "scan_infrastructure_drift", result: {drift_report: [{resource, expected, actual, drift_type, timestamp}]}}

POST /api/tools/scan_infrastructure_drift with body {"hostname":"no-baseline-host"} -> Receive 412 precondition_failed with {status: "precondition_failed", tool: "scan_infrastructure_drift", error: "No baseline or no PROXMOX_HOST configured"}

features.name: External Dependency Preflight
features.description: Cross-cutting preflight feature: TCP connect probe (1s timeout) for tools that target external hosts. Returns 424 failed_dependency and includes host/port/protocol/requires fields on failure. Local-only tools and GitHub/template reads are not preflighted.
user_flows: POST /api/tools/ssh_execute_command with body {"hostname":"192.168.1.14","command":"uptime"} -> Server runs TCP preflight to 192.168.1.14:22 -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", result: "<uptime>"} (happy path when port 22 accepts TCP)

POST /api/tools/ssh_execute_command with body {"hostname":"down.example.com","command":"uptime"} -> Server runs TCP preflight to down.example.com:22 -> Receive 424 failed_dependency with {status: "failed_dependency", host: "down.example.com", port:22, protocol:"SSH", error, requires}
POST /api/tools/search_proxmox_scripts with body {"query":"backup"} -> No preflight (GitHub request) -> Receive 200 with {status: "success", scripts: [...] }

features.name: External Dependency Preflight
features.description: TCP-connect probe (1s timeout) runs before each tool that targets an external host, returning HTTP 424 with host/port/protocol/requires fields when the target is unreachable. Applies to 26 tools across SSH (port 22) and Proxmox (port 8006). Standalone tools (local DB / GitHub / template reads) are not preflighted.

known_limitations.issue: Authentication mode is fixed at server start (--no-auth or --api-key); cannot toggle per-request, so test suites must run two separate servers to exercise both modes.
known_limitations.impact: Auth coverage requires multiple test runs against differently-configured servers.

known_limitations.issue: Preflight uses TCP-connect only — does not validate SSH/Proxmox protocol handshake. A host with port 22/8006 open but a different service listening will pass the probe.
known_limitations.impact: False positives possible; preflight is a fast-fail mechanism, not a correctness check.

known_limitations.issue: bulk_discover_and_map and infrastructure-lifecycle tools target multiple hosts and do not undergo preflight; per-host failures surface inside the response body.
known_limitations.impact: 424 contract does not apply to these endpoints.

known_limitations.issue: Proxmox tools resolve target from request body field 'host'; PROXMOX_HOST environment variable is not currently used as a fallback for preflight (handler may still use it).
known_limitations.impact: Requests omitting 'host' bypass preflight even when PROXMOX_HOST is set.
